Read-only audit in /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq.

Goal: Document the CURRENT state of the 6 stuck homepage sections so we can write a precise final-pass fix plan. We are in plan mode — read only, no edits.

Files to read in full:
1. src/components/home/hero.tsx + hero.module.css
2. src/components/home/portfolio-carousel.tsx + portfolio-carousel.module.css
3. src/components/home/how-it-works.tsx + how-it-works.module.css
4. src/components/home/pricing-section.tsx + pricing-section.module.css
5. src/components/home/comparison.tsx + comparison.module.css
6. src/components/home/faq-section.tsx + faq-section.module.css
7. src/app/globals.css (for body baseline)
8. tests/homepage.spec.ts (probe spec)
9. tests/screenshots/diff-report.json (latest drift report)

For EACH section, report:

A. Component (.tsx):
   - Number of items rendered
   - Any inline `style={{ ... }}` blocks (these are red flags — should be CSS module classes)
   - Any next/image components: `width`, `height`, `sizes`, `style` props
   - Any "use client" directives + state hooks
   - Any breakpoint-driven conditional rendering

B. CSS Module (.module.css):
   - All `@media` blocks present (which breakpoints covered)
   - Padding values at every breakpoint for the section root
   - Card/cell padding at every breakpoint
   - Image rules: `width`, `height`, `max-height`, `aspect-ratio`, `object-fit`
   - Any "compensation hacks" (look for comments mentioning "live", "compensation", "extra", "padding-bottom: 38px" type ad-hoc adjustments)

C. Diff status (from diff-report.json — for that section):
   - dh per viewport
   - All `computedDiff` props per viewport

Special focus questions:

Q1. HOW IT WORKS: Is the Image component using `width=1492 height=840` or `height=1724`? What does the Webflow markup actually specify? Does the CSS have any `max-height` constraint?

Q2. PRICING: At 375 viewport, do the 3 cards stack vertically? What's the per-card padding in the .module.css? Does `.pricingTableWrapper` have `overflow-x: auto`?

Q3. HERO: At 375, are the buttons stacked column or row? What's the GuideJar iframe wrapper height? What's `.div-job-attention.mob-margin-less` margin?

Q4. PORTFOLIO CAROUSEL: Was the `max-height` clamp on `.gallery-image-outer` removed in a prior pass? What constrains image height now?

Q5. COMPARISON: How many cards in the right column (Boldteq Way)? Are all 3 message cards rendered in .tsx? Any min-height on cards?

Q6. FAQ: At 768 (which media query applies?), how is the .fq-outer-grid laid out? Single column or two?

Output a structured markdown report. Read-only investigation. Do not modify any files.
